message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src/core/thread/mle.cpp","function":"Mle::HandleParentResponse","line":3350,"var":"challenge","code":"SuccessOrExit(error = Tlv::GetTlv(aMessage, Tlv::kChallenge, sizeof(challenge), challenge));","note":"A peer-supplied Parent Response carries the Challenge TLV that seeds the stored challenge bytes and length."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/core/thread/mle.cpp","function":"Mle::HandleParentResponse","line":3352,"var":"mChildIdRequest.mChallengeLength","code":"mChildIdRequest.mChallengeLength = challenge.GetChallengeLength();","note":"The parsed Challenge TLV length is copied into the child-id request state and later reused when generating a response."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/core/thread/mle.cpp","function":"Mle::HandleParentResponse","line":3353,"var":"mChildIdRequest.mChallenge","code":"memcpy(mChildIdRequest.mChallenge, challenge.GetChallenge(), mChildIdRequest.mChallengeLength);","note":"The attacker-controlled challenge bytes are stored in the fixed-size child-id request buffer."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/core/thread/mle.cpp","function":"Mle::HandleChildUpdateRequest","line":3556,"var":"challenge","code":"if (Tlv::GetTlv(aMessage, Tlv::kChallenge, sizeof(challenge), challenge) == OT_ERROR_NONE)","note":"A crafted Child Update Request can also supply a Challenge TLV that is parsed into the same fixed-size object."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/core/thread/mle.cpp","function":"Mle::HandleChildUpdateRequest","line":3565,"var":"challenge","code":"SuccessOrExit(error = SendChildUpdateResponse(tlvs, numTlvs, challenge));","note":"That parsed Challenge TLV is forwarded into response generation, preserving the attacker-controlled length."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/core/thread/mle.cpp","function":"Mle::SendChildUpdateResponse","line":2386,"var":"Tlv::kResponse","code":"case Tlv::kResponse:","note":"When the device builds a Child Update Response, it emits a Response TLV using the forwarded challenge state."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/core/thread/mle.cpp","function":"Mle::SendChildUpdateResponse","line":2387,"var":"aChallenge.GetLength()","code":"SuccessOrExit(error = AppendResponse(*message, aChallenge.GetChallenge(), aChallenge.GetLength()));","note":"The stored challenge length is passed directly into AppendResponse, so any oversized length becomes the TLV length for serialization."},
{"step":8,"file":"src/core/thread/mle.cpp","function":"Mle::AppendResponse","line":1194,"var":"tlv.SetLength(aResponseLength)","code":"tlv.SetLength(aResponseLength);","note":"AppendResponse writes that length into the Response TLV header without bounding it to the 8-byte payload buffer."},
{"step":9,"file":"src/core/common/message.cpp","function":"Message::Write","line":534,"var":"memcpy(GetFirstData() + aOffset, aBuf, bytesToCopy)","code":"memcpy(GetFirstData() + aOffset, aBuf, bytesToCopy);","note":"Serialization copies bytes from the ResponseTlv object past its fixed mResponse array, causing the stack-buffer-overflow read sink."},
{"step":10,"file":"src/core/thread/mle_tlvs.hpp","function":"ResponseTlv","line":392,"var":"mResponse","code":"class ResponseTlv : public Tlv","note":"ResponseTlv contains only an 8-byte response buffer, so any length above 8 makes the serializer read beyond the object boundary."}
]
path=pathlib.Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
path.write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(path.read_text())
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/candidate_trace.json /workspace/candidate_trace.json
